output.root_problem: A gateway configuration change (CHG-77, 2026-09-09) disabled idempotency_key_enforcement on capture retries and was never rolled back (E-01). Steady-rate gateway-timeout retries (~120/day, E-02/E-05) are then sent to the PSP without an idempotency key, so the PSP stops deduplicating them and processes each retry as a new charge (E-03), which is why orders_with_2_captures jumped from 0 to tracking daily retry volume exactly from 09-09 onward (E-02) and double-charge tickets spiked ~27x the same week with flat order volume (E-04).
output.requested_solution: Build an AI assistant that drafts apology replies to customers who complain about being charged twice.

causal_chain: Gateway-timeout automatic capture retries occur at a steady background rate (~117-124/day) regardless of configuration (E-02, E-05).
On 2026-09-09, SH-PAY disabled idempotency_key_enforcement on the payment gateway via change CHG-77 to debug capture latency, intending it as temporary, and it was never rolled back (E-01).
Without an idempotency key, the PSP no longer deduplicates gateway-timeout capture retries and instead processes each retry as a new charge (E-03).
orders_with_2_captures goes from 0 on 2026-09-07/08 (despite ~120 retries/day) to 118 and 124 on 09-09/09-10, tracking that day's retry count almost 1:1 (E-02).
Double-charge support tickets jump from 9-11/week (W35-W36) to 288-301/week (W37-W38) starting the week containing CHG-77, with order volume flat (E-04).

remedies.feasibility_rationale: E-05/E-07 confirm this is a single reversible gateway setting change; SH-OPS already holds the DA-SET-CAPTURE-IDEMPOTENCY grant and K-GW defines the required runtime-confirmation gate, so the mechanism exists and is actionable within the 225-minute remaining budget.
remedies.residual_gap: Does not resolve U-LATENCY-ISSUE-STATUS (whether the original capture-latency problem that motivated disabling enforcement was fixed, risking recurrence of timeouts) or U-CONFIG-AUDIT-COMPLETENESS (possible unlogged concurrent config changes).

remedies.description: Add a process/ownership control requiring any 'temporary' gateway config change (like CHG-77) to carry a mandatory expiry date and an owner (SH-PAY/SH-OPS) responsible for scheduled rollback or review.
remedies.feasibility_rationale: This is a policy/documentation change to the change-management process, not a protected action, so it can be drafted and agreed within contest time without triggering K-GW.
remedies.residual_gap: Prevents recurrence of this failure mode but does not fix the current incident, verify latency status, or remediate already-affected customers.

remedies.description: Run a read-only payments-db query (DA-CHG) for all orders_with_2_captures since 2026-09-09 and assign the resulting list to payments operations for refund processing, addressing VOB-U-EXISTING-DUPLICATE-REMEDIATI.
remedies.feasibility_rationale: payments-db is a HEALTHY, read-only tool already in the surface; querying it is unconstrained, though actual refund disbursement is an ownership/process step that may extend past the rehearsal window.
remedies.residual_gap: Does not stop the ongoing duplicate-capture mechanism (that is R-REENABLE's job) and the full scope/cost of refunds remains unknown until the query runs and SH-OPS/finance act on it.

output.why_agent_needed: Two HIGH-criticality unknowns (U-LATENCY-ISSUE-STATUS, U-CONFIG-AUDIT-COMPLETENESS) require synthesizing stakeholder follow-up with SH-PAY/SH-OPS and cross-checking logs rather than a deterministic rule, and these gate the open VOBs required before release; an agent is also useful to draft residual remediation messaging for already-double-charged customers, distinct from the rejected H-COMMS-SOLUTION framing.
